cards.title: MRT Definition in Michaelis-Menten Systems
cards.claim: In systems with Michaelis-Menten elimination, Mean Residence Time (MRT) is defined as a function of the steady-state volume of distribution and time-average clearance, where time-average clearance is calculated as Dose/AUC.
conditions: Intravenous administration into one- or two-compartment systems.
Applicability check required: Dose/AUC represents time-average clearance, not necessarily constant clearance.
limitations: Abstract-only source; specific equations for Vss derivation in nonlinear contexts are not provided.
Does not specify handling of BLQ or censoring in the nonlinear context.
Specific numerical thresholds for 'validity' are not detailed in the abstract.
cards.downstream_use: Use this definition to interpret MRT in nonlinear PK studies. Do not assume linear clearance assumptions apply. Use Dose/AUC as the operational definition for time-average clearance in these specific nonlinear models.

note: Method/reference scope retained; source identity is available in original evidence.
